summary.headline: Astrological Topics, Entries 383–400
summary.text: Catalog entries 383–400 from a Greek astrological codex, covering Harranian methods and the cosmic year, the Dog Star, lunar phases and configurations, planetary faces and terms, runaways, weather phenomena, foundations, aphetic places, planetary powers, and places where the five planets rejoice. Entry 400 begins Paul of Alexandria’s introduction to the apotelesmata, with cross-references to Florentine codices.
